name: code-block
title: Code block
purpose: Present source code or commands with accessible compact text actions and icon-only copy.
accessibility: Syntax color supplements rather than replaces the source text.
Optional line numbers are hidden from assistive technology and excluded from copied source.
Collapsed previews retain the complete source in the document and expose keyboard-accessible See more and Show less actions.
The copy result is announced through a polite live region.
The icon-only copy control has a stable accessible name.
Header actions retain their own accessible group names.

The Glassmorphism material remains dark, gives labels and outline header actions an explicit code-surface contrast context, and restores an opaque code surface for increased contrast or reduced transparency.
commonMistakes: Using it as an editable editor.
Forcing wrapping for long commands that must remain exact.
Making the Glassmorphism surface so transparent that it no longer reads as a consistently dark code surface.

examples.title: Collapsed preview
examples.description: Long source can start compact and expand over a bottom fade.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import CodeBlock from "@/components/ui/CodeBlock.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <CodeBlock code="const background = '#101114';
const foreground = '#f4f4f5';
const surface = '#18191d';
const primary = '#f5f5f4';
const secondary = '#a1a1aa';
const accent = '#93c5fd';" label="Configuration" language="shell" :collapsed-lines="5" />
</template>

examples.title: Line numbers
examples.description: Visual line numbers can support longer reference examples.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import CodeBlock from "@/components/ui/CodeBlock.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <CodeBlock code="const placeholder = true;
const value = placeholder ? 1 : 0;" label="Vue" language="shell" line-numbers />
</template>

examples.title: Wrapped
examples.description: Wrapped code keeps long commands within narrow layouts.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import CodeBlock from "@/components/ui/CodeBlock.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <CodeBlock code="echo "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod tempor"" label="Code placeholder" language="shell" wrap />
</template>

examples.title: Without copy
examples.description: Hide the copy action when the snippet is illustrative rather than reusable.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import CodeBlock from "@/components/ui/CodeBlock.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <CodeBlock code="echo "Lorem ipsum placeholder"" label="Code placeholder" language="shell" :copyable="false" />
</template>
